description.value: Frog City Cafe is a seasonal cafe and live music venue set within a 6-acre heritage garden in Kaleden, BC, operated by owners with deep personal ties to the land and the Hayter family who built it. The menu centers on house-baked breads turned into hearty sandwiches and salads at lunch, with Neapolitan flatbreads served on live-music evenings and weekend breakfasts in peak season. The dog-friendly garden patio, rotating art and music shows, and a strong community ethos make it an unexpectedly rich cultural stop along the Okanagan cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides address (315 Linden Ave, Kaleden, BC), menu, and venue details. No bike-specific amenities—parking, racks, Wi-Fi, charging, pump—are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. The menu includes explicitly vegetarian items (The Hippy sandwich, Chickpea Salad Sandwich, Frog City Salad), supporting a true value for vegetarian options; no GF or vegan labeling is present.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Penticton' but website address is '315 Linden Ave, Kaleden, B.C.' — Kaleden is a distinct community approximately 15 km south of Penticton; OSM placement should be verified.
No phone number is available in OSM tags or on the website.
OSM has no address tag; address taken entirely from website footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operating seasonal cafe with a substantial food menu, dog-friendly garden patio, and live events in a scenic Okanagan location; a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists even though bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: The cafe promotes several nearby accommodation options (Airbnbs, Ponderosa Point Resort, Linden House, etc.) under its STAY page, which may be useful context for multi-day touring itineraries in the Kaleden area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes The Hippy (vegetarian sandwich with Swiss, guac, cucumbers, sunflower seeds, greens), Chickpea Salad Sandwich, and Frog City Salad; no explicit GF or vegan labeling found
